from collections import Counter


def background(g):
    """Most common color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for r in g for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]


def linecolor(g, i, axis):
    """Dominant color of row (axis=0) or column (axis=1) i."""
    vals = g[i] if axis == 0 else [g[r][i] for r in range(len(g))]
    return Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]


def framework_lines(g):
    """Rows and columns whose dominant color differs from the background."""
    bg = background(g)
    H, W = len(g), len(g[0])
    rows = [i for i in range(H) if linecolor(g, i, 0) != bg]
    cols = [j for j in range(W) if linecolor(g, j, 1) != bg]
    return rows, cols


def intersection_marks(g):
    """(row, col, color) of framework intersections whose color differs from both crossing lines' colors."""
    rows, cols = framework_lines(g)
    return [(i, j, g[i][j]) for i in rows for j in cols
            if g[i][j] != linecolor(g, i, 0) and g[i][j] != linecolor(g, j, 1)]


def rare_block_matrix(g, fill=None):
    """Lattice summary of intersection marks: rows = consecutive pairs of rows
    containing marks, columns = consecutive pairs of framework columns; entry =
    the shared corner color if all four block corners equal one mark color, else
    the background color (or `fill`)."""
    rows, cols = framework_lines(g)

    bg = background(g)
    fill = bg if fill is None else fill
    colors = {c for _, _, c in marks}

        out.append(row)
